```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(srvyr)
library(mice)
```

```{r Loading the Dataset}
rhfs <- read.csv("RHFS_2024_Public_Variables.csv")

# Turning Categorical Variables into Factors
rhfs <- rhfs |> 
  mutate(
    across(
      c(NUMCAT_R, OUTCOME, PROPCON, PROPTOWN,
        COMPLEX, NUMBLD_R, YRNEWBLG_R, YRPROPACQ_R, APPRWAIVER,
        CASHDWN, HOWACQ, HOWMVAL, OFFSTPARKAHS, UNITSTAT,
        ADAGENCY, ADAGENT, ADNEWSPAPER, ADONLINE, ADOTHONLINE,
        ADVERTISE, ADWEBSITE, MLS, MNGMNT, NUMOTHPROP,
        NUMOTHUNITS, OWNENT, OWNOTHPROP, COMMSPACE, CONCSS,
        ICABLE, IELEC, IGAS, IPARKING, IPOOL,
        ISEWER, ITRASH, IWATER, IWIFI, LEASLNG,
        LNGTRMPRV, NORNTAPPFEE, PAYAPP, PAYCASH, PAYCHK,
        PAYCREDIT, PAYONLINE, PAYOTH, PAYTHIRD, RCONTROLAHS,
        RECCOMMREN, RNTAPPFEEWAIV, SECDEPAMT, SENIOR, WEEKLNG,
        OPTAX_R, PROPANS, ACCEPT, BENEOTH, ECONDEVLP,
        ELDERLY, GOVBELOW, GOVGRANT, HISTORIC, LOWINAREA,
        LOWINCTEN, OTHRCV, RSUBSIDY, STLOWINC, YRMORT_R,
        DEBT, DEBT1, GREENMORT, LOCTYP, MORTGET,
        PMTFREQ, REGPAY, RPIPMI, RPIPRIN, RPIPRPINS,
        RPIPRPTAX, WHYNOMRT, SAMPSTRATA, MORTAMT_R, OUTBAL_R, RNTAPPFEE_R, 
        YRPROPREHAB_R), 
      as.factor
    )
   )

# Renaming some factor levels for later convenience
rhfs <- rhfs |> 
  mutate(
    NUMCAT_R = fct_recode(
      NUMCAT_R, 
      "1 Unit" = "0", 
      "2-4 Units" = "1", 
      "5-24 Units" = "2", 
      "25-49 Units" = "3", 
      "50+ Units" = "4"
    ), 
    OUTCOME = fct_recode(
      OUTCOME, 
      "Interview Compl; self response" = "1", 
      "Assisted living limited interview; self response" = "3", 
      "Conversion from partial to full interview" = "5", 
      "Interview Compl; field interview" = "201", 
      "Assisted living limited interview; field interview" = "203", 
      "Sufficient partial; field interview" = "204", 
      "Military limited field interview" = "206"
    )
  )
```

```{r Survey Data Setup}
# Loads the data frame with srvyr
df <- rhfs |> 
  select(-REPWGT0) |> # REPWGT0 is equivalent to WEIGHT
  as_survey_rep(
    repweights = starts_with("REPWGT"), 
    weights = WEIGHT, 
    type = "successive-difference", 
    combined_weights = TRUE, 
    # Decided to set to T to follow SDR as outlined by Ash (to match what was
    # done in Census's Methodology)
    mse = TRUE
  )

# Sanity check for if the data was successfully loaded with srvyr
# using Table 5 of Census's RHFS Methodology
df |> 
  summarize(
    properties = survey_total(vartype = "se") # Applies weights and calculates se of properties
  ) |> 
  mutate( # Dividing by 1000 to match Table 5's scale
    properties = properties / 1000, 
    properties_se = properties_se / 1000, 
    moe = properties_se * 1.645 # 90% margin of error
  )
```

```{r Cleaning the Dataset}
# Makes View(rhfs) much more productive.
rhfs <- rhfs |> 
  select(-starts_with("REPWGT"), -WEIGHT, 
         -SURVYR, -CONTROLPUF, # is always 2024, ID isn't useful in data analysis
         # J flag variables mark values that were manually reviewed; note that
         # they may become relevant if outliers are under scrutiny.
         -starts_with("J"), 
         # A continuous variable coded as a factor without documentation; may
         # be useful for pure prediction
         -PCTFEEWAIV_R
         )

# NAs in the dataset
missingvalues <- function(df) {
  NAs <- sum(sapply(df, \(x) sum(x == -8))) # Not applicable
  NRs <- sum(sapply(df, \(x) sum(x == -9))) # Not reported
  
  tibble(
    NAs = NAs, # Not applicable
    NRs = NRs, # Not reported
    perc.missing = (NAs + NRs) / prod(dim(df)) # % of missing values in the df
  )
}
missingvalues(rhfs)

# Missing values by interview type
rhfs |> 
  summarize(
    # pick(everything()) extracts a data frame of all non-grouping columns
    missingvalues(pick(everything())), 
    .by = OUTCOME
  )

# Handling known Trivially Missing values
# Certain values in the columns below can only exist if REGPAY is 1, so -9 is 
# wrongly assigned to them.
trivially.missing.regpays <- rhfs |> 
  mutate(id = row_number()) |> 
  filter( 
    REGPAY == -9 & 
      # In given observation, if any of these columns contain a value other than
      # -8 or -9 return True.
      if_any(c(PMTAMT_R, PMTFREQ, RPIPRIN, RPIPRPINS, RPIPMI, RPIPRPTAX), \(x) !x %in% c(-8, -9))
    ) |>
  select(id, REGPAY, PMTAMT_R, PMTFREQ, RPIPRIN, RPIPRPINS, RPIPMI, RPIPRPTAX) |> 
  pull(id)

rhfs$REGPAY[trivially.missing.regpays] <- 1

# Evidence for MAR (missing at random) in MRKTVAL_R
df |> 
  mutate(
    mrktNA = MRKTVAL_R == -9
  ) |> 
  summarize(
    survey_mean(mrktNA), 
    .by = NUMCAT_R
  )

df |> 
  filter(MRKTVAL_R != -9) |> 
  summarize( 
    mean_mrktval = survey_mean(MRKTVAL_R), 
    median_mrktval = survey_median(MRKTVAL_R), 
    .by = NUMCAT_R 
  )
```
